formAbout: A survey form (schema 9.14.0): «required», a disabled button, a number field, a write for the choice of a group. The groups below are added to the same table; the data is x-style.layout.form. In formCases every state is the data layers of the screen (record, session, host, data) and the answer: whether the form of each screen is filled and whether the named node is disabled. In pressCases, disabledLookCases and choiceSessionCases there is no host data at all: the screen holds only what the person typed. The numbers 12.0, -0.0, 1e2, 1e-7 are written so on purpose: JSON.stringify would erase the trap for Dart.

choiceNote: Choice built from plain nodes (schema 9.19.0): a node whose action is «setValue» is an option, a node whose action is «toggleValue» is a toggle; options that are children of one parent and write the same path are one group. The data is x-choice and x-actions.write. In choicePlaceCases «siblings» are the children of one parent in document order, «hidden» names the ones that are not shown, «places» gives [position, size] or null. In choiceControlCases and writeFormCases the host gave no data at all: the screen holds only «session» and what the presses wrote; «expect» is read from the finished screen — «absent» means the node is not on it, a missing key means the attribute is not there.

inputPartsNote: 9.19.0, parts of a text field — NEW groups, the groups above are untouched: the box of the field itself (fieldBoxCases), the row inside the box with a mark at the start and at the end (affixRowCases), the text of the character counter (counterCases), the row under the box (noteRowCases), documents (partsDocumentCases). Data — «x-style.layout.inputParts». Starts are measured from the LOGICAL start of the box by the direction of the SCREEN; the left edge in a right-to-left screen is «box − start − width» (rows with «rtl» give it). «null» means «absent».

emptinessNote: Schema 9.19.0: `isEmpty` / `isNotEmpty` are legal on a path of ANY type (`x-conditions`), and what is judged is the VALUE under the path, not the type of the path. `emptinessCases`: `value` is what lies under the path (no `value` key — nothing lies there); `isEmpty` and `isNotEmpty` are the answers of the two operators. `emptinessDocumentCases`: `condition` stands as `disabledIf` of a button; `codes` are the codes of the validator (empty: publishable). The paths are of the default data contract: `survey.goal` a text, `survey.score` a number, `survey.agreed` a flag, `offer.endsAt` a date, `items` a collection.

valuePathNote: Schema 9.23.0: a comparison may take its operand from ANOTHER data path — «valuePath» instead of «value», with the same comparison operators (rules: x-listFilter.valuePath). `valuePathCases`: `condition` stands as `visibleIf` (or `styleWhen`, `disabledIf` — one form), `data` is the flat scope both paths are read in, `holds` is the answer. No value under «valuePath» (absent, null, the empty string) — the condition does NOT hold, `eq` and `neq` alike; inside «Repeater.where» the same comparison holds for every record (repeater-filter-cases.json).
